notes.title: New Update Now Live - Stuttering Effect Solved
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have noticed a handful of reports from players saying they are experiencing what appears to be a stuttering effect in game. This looks visually like a low frame rate, however the game itself it running at a much higher frame rate.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/0b1286207e2a6b7cbc5b982b90a940ddf3201b18.jpg[/img]

This issue is caused by a change in how often the physics system updates in the game - this was changed to help optimise the game further on lower end machines, but created a stuttering effect on higher end machines because of the difference between the physics update and the frame rate on screen. 

To address this, the physics will now update much quicker in game and should remove stuttering effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5b2541b23a37a7eb46a976aaab2ce490673fd29c.png[/img]

We have also given the player the ability to further adjust how often this happens with launch options.

However this will make the mouse sensitivity much greater so this may need to be adjusted by the player in game.

[h1]Setting Launch Options[/h1]

- Open your library and locate Jalopy
- Right Click on Jalopy and select "Properties"
- In the general tab, click on "Set Launch Options"
- type in -fixedTime 0.01
- This will trigger the physics at 100 times a second (100fps)

We have also adjusted the default launch options for the game.

The game no longer support opengl and DX11 also will be dropped from the default launch options as this was no longer being utilised.

In place of this you will find alternative launch options which are the following:

Play on low spec PC
Play on high spec PC

These options adjust the physics updates to optimise the game for different types of PCs. 

If you have any issues or require further support.
Please email our team at support@excalibur-games.com

Thanks,
The Jalopy Team

notes.title: Road trip simulator Jalopy reaches full release next week
notes.notes:
Jalopy is a lovely road trip simulator that wheels players around the territories of the former Eastern Bloc. It's been in Early Access since April 2016, and has now set March 28, this Wednesday, for full release. 

When I first discovered former Formula 1 developer Greg Pryjmachuk was partly responsible for Jalopy, I was intrigued. Driving an East German Trabbie-aping Laika 601 Deluxe is a far cry from high-velocity F1 cars, and while I loved my time with it I'm not sure I properly understood it. 

Miodrag Kovachevic's 2017 Now Playing, on the other hand, is a wonderful example of someone who does. As explained in the article's intro, Miodrag grew up in '90s Yugoslavia, an Eastern European country that no longer exists. They speak about their family's Yugo—"a metal box with wheels that was the embodiment of cheap communist cars"—which, despite lasting 27 years, appears to mirror the game's Laika 601 Deluxe.  

Miodrag's insights inspired me to return to Jalopy, which I then found more enjoyable than before. You should absolutely read the piece in its entirety, but I've pulled out a couple of paragraphs below: 

As I drive through procedural ’90s Germany, I don’t recognise any of the environments, but I still feel a sense of nostalgia. My car is slow and the roads are barren, without a single billboard in sight. The radio plays songs that sound like Eastern Europe in the ’90s, (or Western Europe in the ’60s, depending on your perspective). A few infant ’90s tracks tentatively edge themselves in, not yet knowing whether they’re electro or industrial...

When I finally reach Yugoslavia, the game shows off the coastal area—something I’ve never seen before. But the roads still feel familiar. They bend in weird and dangerous ways, while stone hills loom over them. It’s nowhere in Yugoslavia; it’s everywhere in Yugoslavia. I gaze at the sea and reflect upon my journey. Have I changed like my Laika has? Different on the inside, with only the shell still the same? The car breaks down again and I’m reminded that no, it’s still the piece of garbage it has always been. 

Jalopy will launch in full on March 28, and will be subject to a limited-time 40 percent launch discount on Steam. It'll support 19 different languages, too—check out that list full over here.

notes.title: The Uncle Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/1d9c263a4c0b04079320a67341d70327fe1f79ee.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone,

Jalopy receives a pretty major update today which brings back the Uncle and introduces a narrative element to the game.  I’ll go through some of the larger points included in this update, but there will of course be a large change log at the end of this post for you to read in more detail.

[h1]The Uncle Is Back[/h1]
Your second travelling companion (of course, after the Laika 601 Deluxe) asks you to transport him to Turkey. Along the way, he’ll share information of the local area, warn you when your bonnet is open and may help you if you have begun running a bit low on funds. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/0b1286207e2a6b7cbc5b982b90a940ddf3201b18.jpg[/img]

There’s always been a divide of opinion on the uncle, some love him and his dimension shifting jacket, while others have a hatred that matches that of standing bare foot on a Lego piece. So with that in mind, once you complete the tutorial and complete your first route. When you load up the game you will be given the option to either have him accompany you on your journey or leave him behind. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/81f7089bd8b780ec2f165b7afd29e9e3e4c2378a.jpg[/img]

Uncle may still be a little buggy. But do let us know if he begins to misbehave!
Of course, the narrative elements introduced via the uncle is something that you should discover yourself. We hope you enjoy the story!

[h1]Steering Wheel Support[/h1]
The latest build adds steering wheel support, but there is a massive disclaimer we need to mention. We have been performing some tests internally and there are still issues with this. There are still many wheels that are not yet functioning correctly and is something that is being looked at.  If you experience non-functioning pedals, or the view rotates without any input, we highly recommend that you continue to use a mouse and keyboard or a game pad instead. 

[h1]Statistics[/h1]
If you’ve ever wanted to know how many footsteps you’ve taken, how many tyres you’ve popped and what your top speed is, you’re in luck! The statistics screen now tracks many of your actions while playing. I’ll be personally curious to see who will be able to reach the highest speed in their Laika 601 Deluxe.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/8a106bb2b857120d2f546c1d87c1dddcc69c98d5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
Achievements have been added! There are some particularly easy achievements that ca n be obtained within minutes, but then there’s some tough ones for those staying for the long haul. Good luck everyone!

[h1]Trabant Car Challenge with Hat Films[/h1]
And finally, we have been working with Hat Films to create a three part series where the guys from Hat films drive a couple of Trabants. The first episode is live now, you can watch it below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEOgev7e_Vw

So, there we go! This update helps to fill a narrative shaped hole which was in Jalopy. Of course, there are a few dozen fixes for some issues as well. If you experience any issues, do let us know in the forums! Thankyou everyone for the support and patience as we’ve been working on this update.

If you'd like to read the full change logs click the link below:

[url=https://www.excalibur-publishing.com/blogs/news/jalopy-uncle-update] Change Log[/url]

notes.title: 22nd of June Update - Border Guard Issue Fixed! Sorry To Keep You Weighting
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Some major fixes today which fix a progress stopping bug which was introduced in the last update. We'd like to thank everyone who has taken the time to let us know about this and helped us locate it. You guys are awesome!

Other additions and changes have been based on the weight of the car, this includes fixes to the digital dash, weight effecting tyre grip as well as the acceleration of your vehicle. 

I hope the awful headline now makes a bit more sense... Sorry about that

The full change log is below!

[h1]Build 0.83[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed index issue with the User Manual 
[*]Digital Dash now updates weight icon correctly 
[*]Digital Dash weight alert values increased 
[*]Fixed issue where more weight on the car actually made it accelerate faster... 
[*]Increased effective of total car weight on tyre grip by 10x (more tyre grip when carrying heavier cargo) 
[*]Car Weight reduction to acceleration increased by 10x (cargo weight now greatly reduces acceleration) 
[*]Car weight now affects acceleration performance incrementally, based on the base power of the installed engine (i.e. if you have an old, broken engine, weight will be even more of an issue than if you had a sweet engine fully repaired) 
[*]Fuel mix now affects engine audio 
[*]Engine condition now affects engine audio 
[*]Cursor off in the pause menu now works 
[*]Fixed issue with ignition coils going below 0 condition. 
[*]Fixed text delay on Motel owner 
[*]Fixed baskets leaving two items in the basket when trying to bulk sell 
[*]fuel can should now close it's lid after refueling it 
[*]moved 2-stroke, fuel cans, car jacks, crowbars, water & buckets over to the new pricing system 
[*]Fixed border typo : "you will be charged" to "You will be charged" (thanks "that guy") [/list]

[h1]Build 0.831[/h1]
[list][*]Removed old price tag for tyre repair kit 
[*]Fixed soft lock with border guards searching cars without a roof rack
[*]Fixed some more delays in dialogue text 
[*]Fixed car shaking when failing to start ignition[/list]

As always, let us know if you spot any bugs! Thanks everyone and we hope you enjoy this update.

A new update has just gone live which predominately fixes some of the low FPS some machines are having. There are a few changes to the ignition coil, border patrol and how you interact with the world with regards to bad driving and disturbing motel guests!

- Border Guards now search roof inventory

notes.title: Bulgaria Update Out Now! Tyres, New Cashier System, New Music and 33% off
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/4a3d7dfc04bdb5cbceb72f10b66adbdb624a55b7.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

Jalopy has just received a brand new update which brings with it some adjustments to tyre wear, new tyre types, more music tracks Bulgaria to explore and a selection of other changes and fixes. For just a brief look at some of the changes, you can watch the trailer for the Bulgaria route here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PNqvW88vtwE
Those of you who want to know more about the changes, I’ll go into a lttle more detail below:

[h1]New Tyre System[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/12f9d596ee0afc95d2d2c0fa7cefa25c64f384e2.png[/img]

Previously, players would need to just replace their tyres when they burst. Now, we have a selection of different conditions which affect tyre traction. If you’re driving in pouring rain, you’re going to want wet tyres, if you fancy off roading, you’re probably going to want to fit some off road tyres.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/9230625f76d801042a4a1de83af5db4ba31c1bce.png[/img]

The tyres can be purchased from petrol stations and the Autershop at the end of each route and come in several variants including soft, medium and hard compound.

Soft Compound: Tyres wear at a faster rate but have an increased level of grip
Medium Compound: Tyres wear at an average rate and have an average level of grip
Hard compound: Tyres wear at a slower rate but they have a decreased level grip

Remember, your Laika 601 Deluxe can store two tyres in the trunk, but you can hold additional tyres with the officially licensed roof rack which can be found inside Laika Dealerships.

[h1]New Music[/h1]
Jeremy has been at it again and has created two more tracks for Jalopy! 

[h1]New Cashier system[/h1]
When selling goods, you now may be alerted by the cashier that they can’t afford to buy what you are selling. When choosing a route, the cashiers on the route will spawn with a certain number of finances available to them, up to 300. We have seen some playthroughs where a lucky spawn for a crate of wine will give players a massive influx of cash which makes upgrading your car much more satisfying.

Bear in mind though, that while the cashier may not be able to afford the goods you want to sell with cash, you may be able to exchange it for any items in the shop. Make sure to place the goods you want to trade it for onto the counter first before placing the goods you want to sell.

[h1]Bulgaria[/h1]

This is the penultimate location for Jalopy. It features large off road areas, winding roads and flooded off road tracks. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/faa1c3f7709e0f99ab125cd26c56eba86a98fca5.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/49013dca558d1459c14add32d1ecb030eebc4899.png[/img]

Greg is now at work on the Turkey route, which will be the final destination in Jalopy. Once that’s been added we will start looking at several other features including driving back home. More details will be shared in the coming weeks

To celebrate the new Bulgaria update, we have also put the game into a 33% off discount on Steam.

As always, thank you for the support, if you experience any issues, let us know in the forums or email us at support@excalibur-publishing.com

notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today we are releasing a new update to Jalopy which adds a new region to drive your Laika 601 deluxe and also adds some new features and bug fixes. First I’d like to thank everyone who has been a part of the public beta branch and has reported any bugs or issues, this type of feedback has really helped us make sure that the build is good to go once it releases to everyone.
So what’s in the new update? I’ll detail some of the core changes below but a compiled changelog will be at the very bottom of this announcement.

Those who want to watch the update in action check out the video below, scroll further down and we’ll detail what each of the mechanics do in more detail

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nOMoACw8NfQ

[h1]Yugoslavia[/h1]
The next stop in our pilgrimage! The coastal region of Yugoslavia features some stunning horizon vistas and winding roads.

[img]http://imgur.com/L91ks7V.jpg[/img]
[img]http://imgur.com/j4Iloxy.jpg[/img]
[img]http://imgur.com/Ez45LS7.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Digital Dash Display[/h1]
The digital dash display is  just one of three new major upgrades that can be bought from the Laika dealership. This piece of tech will provide a visual display on your dashboard to alert you of any issues with the engine, oil levels and tyre durability. 

[img]http://imgur.com/FzkaUf2.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Tool Rack[/h1]
The tool rack contains three items, the car jack, a spanner and a crowbar. Installing this upgrade means that there will be a dedicated space for all three of these items without compromising any of the available space in your trunk. The spanner included in the tool rack can be used to repair engine components. The level of damage that the spanner can repair is based around the level of the tool kit itself.

[img]http://imgur.com/9Ru6rtM.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Light Rack[/h1]
The final upgrade is the Light rack. Installing this will allow for better visibility at night by providing a more powerful beam of light. 

[img]http://imgur.com/dZgV9ah.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Music[/h1]
Jeremy, who has composed all tracks in the game has added a further two new tracks titled; “Harmonikatalas” and “Krugovi”. Accompanying these new tracks is a visual update to the radio itself.

[img]http://imgur.com/QFnhWKt.jpg[/img]

[h1]Xbox 360 Controller support[/h1]
One of the major requests from players has been to add support for controllers. The xbox 360 controller can now be used for all areas of the game. Those awaiting for wheel support however, this is the first step towards achieving that goal. We’re still looking into it and will have more news to share later.

[img]http://imgur.com/TpTib6E.jpg[/img]

[h1]Car Horn[/h1]
Express yourself with the car horn, someone cut you up? BEEEEEEEP! In a stale mate for the last parking spot? BEEEEEEEP! 

[img]http://imgur.com/6SjIjxq.jpg[/img]

[h1]Baskets[/h1]
On your journey, you’ll secure several boxes. Unfortunately unpacking those from the car and handing each item one by one to the cashier can be quite a tedious process. But with the new-fangled basket technology you can place a larger amount of items in the basket and then bulk sell everything by handing the basket straight to the cashier!

[img]http://imgur.com/nKHeVnT.jpg[/img]

[h1]Home Storage[/h1]
While there are still plenty of other changes (See the changelog below) the last major addition is the Home storage. This an area inside your home garage which will allow you to store car components and paints. You’ll need to buy some boxes first, and then when you travel home (via the pause menu or the map), place the items straight into the boxes and it will save the items placed inside the crates when you save and quit the game.

[img]http://imgur.com/WuWUbvr.jpg[/img]

[*]Fixed issue with unpaid car jacks becoming stuck under the car 
[*]Cleaned up interactions with car jacks staying after driving away 
[*]Fixed crash on load issue[/list]

[h1]Build 0.600[/h1]
[*]Added Yugoslavia 
[*]Magazines now zoom out correctly if picked up while zoomed in 
[*]Refactored how fuel, electric, oil and water are now ready by the car 
[*]Replaced Laika bonnet sigil 
[*]Added car horn 
[*]Added digital dash upgrade 
[*]Added home storage 
[*]Handbrake now sets engine torque / current speed to 0 
[*]Reverse audio now fixed 
[*]Fixed exploit of being able to climb over petrol station counter 
[*]Added correct animated flags to border crossings 
[*]Correct banned goods on border sign when Loading into a town 
[*]Fixed car topping over issue 
[*]Fuel cans will now span in shops empty 
[*]Fixed issue with oil adding 2 charges if tanks was in engine 
[*]Fixed issue with Laika Catalogue UI chaing colour after using paint menu 
[*]Added working mirrors (turn them off/on in settings menu) 
[*]Components now lose value based on their condition 
[*]Fixed component price not showing on the UI Notepad 
[*]Fixed Save corruption issue caused by newspapers + paper cups 
[*]Can no longer put the wallet or passport in the trunk (boot) This would cause save corruption errors 
[*]Rebuilt collision interaction to allow multiple collisions on single object 
[*]Beside alarm clock can now be set to silent (press button in to turn off alarm for next time you wake) [/list]

[h1]Build 0.601[/h1]
[list][*]Added Digital Dash Display upgrade 
[*]Added Tool Rack Upgrade
- Level 1 (first purchase) allows repairing components up to 33% of their max durability 
- Level 2 (second purchase) allows repairing components up to 66% of their max durability 
- Level 3 (third purchase) allows repairing components up to 100% of their max durability 
[*]Also contains a crowbar and a carjack 
[*]Added Light Rack upgrade 
[*]Added Baskets which allow players to place items into and carry (items in the basket will also be saved correctly) 
[*]Fixed issue with front license plate vanishing 
[*]Added 360 pad input support for walking and driving (first iteration) 
[*]Added Antialiasing 
[*]Changed main menu cursor to finger, so it is more apparent 
[*]Cleaned up finger UI 
[*]Lightened the blacks in the game as they were really hard to read on most monitors 
[*]New radio model 
[*]New Bonnet lever model, bonnet moved out further to be more apparent 
[*]Lightened Ambient lighting levels for all conditions to make game brighter 
[*]Removed page zooming from user manual 
[*]Returned street lighting to Towns 
[*]Pathfinding now initiates a rescan on dropping the car down with the car jack, this should prevent the uncle getting stuck during the tutorial 
[*]Added Menu support for 360 controller 
[*]Fixed issue with being able to take keys out of ignition while engine is on 
[*]Fixed home storage issues [/list]

[h1]Build 0.602[/h1]
[list] [*]Fixed screen res issues defaulting to 0x0 
[*]Main Menu book can now be closed with pad input B or Esc key 
[*]Fixed issue with Main Menu book being closed before fully opened yet text still appearing 
[*]Added functionality for using sliders with pad input 
[*]Reset the position of Back and Accept on Main Menu Options screen [/list]

[list][*]Cancel transaction lever now takes into account items in inventories and hands 
[*]Fixed an issue with pump not returning to fuel pump 
[*]Fixed crate locks not rotating with wooden boxes [/list]

[h1]Build 0.604/5[/h1]
[list][*]Further fixes relating to the above[/list]

notes.title: Yugoslavia update public beta now live
notes.notes:
Jalopy is still in Early Access but has been subject to updates and new territories almost constantly since launch and we are now nearing the next major update to include the country once known as Yugoslavia.  

Take a drive along the coastline of what is now known as Croatia along winding roads, discover abandoned lighthouses, scavenge deserted beaches and build your bank balance trading a whole new raft of territory specific goods.  

There are also three new major components to enable the player to upgrade their car.  
•	The Light Rack will give better illumination for improved viewing
•	Digital Dash Display will keep you informed about your cars performance
•	A Tool Rack can be installed to save space in the rear of the car

Players with Xbox 360 controllers can now rejoice, as support for this controller has now been added with plans to support more input devices in the future.

There's also an array of graphical improvements to the game including a rebuilt car dashboard which makes each component much more apparent. The rear and side view mirrors now function as in a real car and support for Anti-Aliasing has also made its way into the game. 

Considerable time has been spent refining some smaller elements of the visual style of the game. For example black shades are now much less dense and with a hint of purple allowing for better contrast on darker monitors.  Night time is less punishingly dark than in previous versions of the game.

Thanks to much community feedback there has been a long list of bug fixes and with loads of surprises to be found in this next update. You can now honk the horn of your Laika to warn oncoming traffic. Save a huge amount of components with the home storage system, lose money on components as their value adjusts dynamically related to their condition, and much more. We really think the wait for this one will have been worth it. 

We fully expect this new update to be added to the Jalopy build on Steam within the next couple of weeks but for those gamers who have already purchased Jalopy, they can access the public beta of the new content by following the steps below. 
  
1.	Open Steam on your PC and go to your library
2.	Right click on Jalopy and then click on Properties
3.	Select the BETAS tab and then in the dropdown menu select public_beta
4.	Once selected, Steam should automatically start downloading the beta content
5.	To opt-out of the beta repeat steps 1- 3 but select NONE in the drop down box

A full list of changes will follow shortly, but for the early birds we won't spoil any surprises just yet.

To wet your appetite even further, here are some screenshots from the latest update.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Welcome To Hungary - Spray Paint, Odometer, Decals, Scrapyard
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today, repairs on the bridge to Hungary have been completed. This means you can drive your very own Laika 601 Deluxe across the Hungary route right now! We are looking forward to seeing players share their screenshots as they explore. However, the new route is not the only addition, there are a variety of features that have been added to compliment the Hungary update.

[h1]Spray Paints[/h1]
The spray can is our first new addition. You will be able to purchase these from your Laika Dealership. However they can only stock a limited number of supplies so you’ll need to visit the shop often to make sure they have the colour you want.

If you have a red coat of paint on your Laika 601 Deluxe, you can spray a blue paint over it to mix the two colours and create a purple variant. Experimenting with colour mixing allows you to create some great personal designs.

[img]http://i.giphy.com/26gJzZNavf1q1GRsA.gif[/img]

You’ll also be able to spray paint the interior of your Laika 601 Deluxe

[img]http://i.giphy.com/l0HlIjWrpq7RXYGqs.gif[/img]

For those looking for a stylistic sheen, then you are going to want to slap some metallic paint on your Laika 601 Deluxe. 

[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6ZsZr73dfn3Zv50Q.gif[/img]

And finally, a special addition to the spray paint are the Decal boxes. The decal boxes allow for more customisation options for your Laika 601 Deluxe and come in several variants. From a classic checkerboard roof to flames.
 
[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6ZtppDDHYrJUYc8w.gif[/img]

The decal system is more than likely to be expanded upon throughout Early Access. Do let us know what kind of decals you would like to have in the comments below.

[h1]Odometer[/h1]
A big request from players has been to keep track of the distance traveled via an Odometer. We’re pleased to reveal that this is a part of the update. 

[img]http://i.giphy.com/3o6Ztn99xqrAofOgVi.gif[/img]

[h1]Country branded items[/h1]
Each region will now have their own brand identity as you travel across the three areas. Coffee from one region will have a graphic change to make players feel like they are truly entering another country. The Petrol stations now also change visually depending on the location.

notes.title: Jalopy Performance Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Today we’re releasing a new update for Jalopy which introduces a few changes to performance. As you know, optimisation is something that we are planning to work on throughout development and it will take some time.

[h1]ChangeLog:[/h1]
[list][*]Flickering lights option in the option menu now works
[*]Work done towards framerate drop at night
[*]Trunks should no longer duplicate items when placing 1x2x1 items in roof rack
[*]Placing engine components into trunk should no longer make your car freak out[/list]

[h1]Adjusting graphic settings:[/h1]
We’ve noticed that V sync can cause the game to suffer from a severe FPS loss. If you are experiencing any FPS drops at night, we recommend you turning off Vsync and SSAO. Running the game on low to medium settings during this can make the game run on our machines at around 90FPS in towns during night, where on high they could drop to about 20FPS.

Do adjust your graphical options, the low poly allows for a lot more leeway on these settings and know that optimisation will continue to be an ongoing process during development.

[h1]Hungary Update[/h1]
Regarding the Hungary update, Greg is working very hard on the core generation of Hungary and will be spending more time refining new features. This will of course go into some internal testing before release and over the next few weeks we will begin to share more details on the update and what features you can look forward to seeing. Thankyou everyone for your patience!

notes.title: A Small Delay To The Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As you may be aware, the date of Jalopy has gone back by about one week to the 22nd of April. There are a couple of reasons for this and I'll happily share details on what we need to work on and why this decision has been made.

Firstly, we came across a rather nasty bug that we have seen some players experience but it had been quite difficult for us to reproduce. This bug caused the game to not display text. One of the problems with this bug is that it seems to affect a number of players in countries outside of the UK. Development is based in England, so we had not come across this issue and were only made aware of it recently. 

As you can expect, this nasty bug will cause quite a lot of issues and it is vital that we try to eliminate this before it is released. We are working very hard to stomp this out and hope we can fix it very soon. While we are hoping to fix this bug as soon as possible, we felt an extra week of development may also give us just a little bit more time to polish up the Early Access release too. 

We know there are a lot of you who are looking forward to the game, a delay is a tough decision we had to make but it is vital that we release the best game we can at launch. While the game will be in Pre-Alpha on release and we admit it will still contain a selection of bugs, issues and unfinished features. Development will thrive on the recommendations of our players, so we need to make sure that everyone can enjoy the game when they boot it up.

Jalopy will release very soon! And we really cannot wait for you all to play it.
